disposition: Cumulative read-budget Hold is caught through ValueError and reported as tree_unavailable. The cap still stops reading, but its advertised reason is inaccurate. Read-time overrun regression remains missing.
Typed versions tuple has no runtime shape guard; a string caller can get substring membership. Only correctly configured typed callers are in this offline PoC scope; no authority is admitted.
Invalid non-int or overflowing fd can escape as raw ctypes/OverflowError rather than typed HOLD. The documented error-containment claim has this limitation.
Entry equality does not establish executable entry_point, target or sources semantics. Projection describes only sampled entries, not usable installation validation or acquisition/loaded provenance.

The existing file-byte negative exercises declared-size preflight only. No claim that cumulative read-budget enforcement has a regression oracle; the documentation hash-budget coverage wording is too broad.
entries_of walks and hashes more than rehash would; work is bounded by owner limits, without a latency or manifest-only-read claim.
A public dataclass is not unforgeable evidence. Consumers must not treat it as authorization; require_authority always HOLDs.
Canonical-record Hold is redundantly caught and rewritten through ValueError. Reason distinctions are not preserved for future changes.
The finite codex/claude literal is not shared with the adapter registry. Future adapter evolution needs an explicit synchronization change.
